changelog.name: v1.0.1
changelog.body:
## SongCue 1.0.1

### Fixes / 修复
- Fix QQ Music for Meizu announcing the first lyric line instead of the song title on first playback.
- Fix missing announcements when QQ Music for Meizu omits the standard title and artist fields during metadata updates.
- Prevent frequent playback-state updates from indefinitely delaying song detection and causing missed announcements.

- 修复魅族版 QQ 音乐首次播放时将第一句歌词当作歌名播报的问题。
- 修复魅族版 QQ 音乐更新元数据时省略普通歌名、歌手字段导致的漏报。
- 修复高频播放状态更新不断推迟歌曲识别、导致漏报的问题。

### Requirements / 使用要求
- Android 13+ (API 33+), Root, and LSPosed with **libxposed API 102** support.
- A working system-default text-to-speech (TTS) engine.
- Restart the scoped music apps after updating the module.

- Android 13+，Root，以及支持 **libxposed API 102** 的 LSPosed 框架。
- 系统默认文字转语音（TTS）引擎可正常使用。
- 更新模块后，请重启已勾选作用域的音乐应用。

Star [SongCue](https://github.com/SoClear/SongCue)

changelog.name: v1.0
changelog.body:
## SongCue 1.0

Initial release / 首次发布

### Features / 功能
- Announce song titles and optionally artists when tracks change.
- Choose whether to announce the artist before or after the title, or not at all.
- Pause music for announcements and resume it afterward.
- Work with music apps through standard Android media sessions.

- 切歌时语音播报歌名和歌手。
- 支持在歌名前、歌名后播报歌手，或不播报歌手。
- 播报时暂停音乐，结束后恢复播放。
- 通过标准 Android 媒体会话适配音乐应用。

### Requirements / 使用要求
- Android 13+ (API 33+).
- Root and an enabled LSPosed framework supporting **libxposed API 102**.
- A working system-default text-to-speech (TTS) engine.
- Enable SongCue in LSPosed, select your music apps as its scope, then restart those apps.

- Android 13+，已获取 Root，并启用支持 **libxposed API 102** 的 LSPosed 框架。
- 系统默认文字转语音（TTS）引擎可正常使用。
- 在 LSPosed 中启用模块并勾选音乐应用作为作用域，然后重启这些应用。

Compatibility depends on the player's media session implementation. Repeat-one playback is not guaranteed to trigger announcements.

兼容性取决于播放器的媒体会话实现，单曲循环不保证触发播报。

Source code / 源码：https://github.com/SoClear/SongCue

# SongCue ## Hear what’s playing | 听见正在播放的歌曲 [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/SoClear/SongCue?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/SoClear/SongCue) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/SoClear/SongCue?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/SoClear/SongCue/releases/latest) ![LSPosed](https://img.shields.io/badge/Powered_by-LSPosed-blue?style=flat-square&logo=android) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-AGPL%20v3-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/SoClear/SongCue/blob/main/LICENSE.txt) [![Min SDK](https://img.shields.io/badge/Min_SDK-33-brightgreen?style=flat-square&logo=android)](https://developer.android.com/about/versions) [![Language](https://img.shields.io/github/languages/top/SoClear/SongCue?style=flat-square&color=blueviolet&logo=kotlin)](https://github.com/SoClear/SongCue) [![GitHub Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/SoClear/SongCue/total?style=flat-square&color=blue&label=GitHub%20Downloads)](https://github.com/SoClear/SongCue/releases) [![LSPosed Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.soclear.songcue/total?style=flat-square&color=orange&label=LSPosed%20Downloads)](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.soclear.songcue/releases) [English](#english) | [简体中文](#简体中文)
--- ## English **SongCue** is an LSPosed module that announces song titles and artists when tracks change, using Android’s media sessions and text-to-speech engine. ### ✨ Features - Automatically announce song titles when tracks change. - Announce the artist before or after the title, or leave it out. - Pause music for the announcement and resume it afterward. - Work with music apps through standard Android media sessions. ### 📦 Requirements & Setup - Android 13+ (API 33+), with root access and an activated LSPosed framework supporting libxposed API 102. - A working system-default text-to-speech engine. SongCue uses its default voice without overriding the language. - Install SongCue, enable it in LSPosed, select your music apps as its scope, then restart those apps. - Open SongCue to configure artist announcements. Compatibility depends on the player’s media session implementation. Announcements may begin after playback starts; repeat-one playback is not guaranteed to trigger an announcement. --- ## 简体中文 **SongCue** 是一个 LSPosed 模块，通过 Android 媒体会话和文字转语音引擎，在切歌时自动播报歌名与歌手。 ### ✨ 功能 - 切歌时自动播报歌名。 - 可在歌名前或歌名后播报歌手，也可不播报歌手。 - 播报时暂停音乐，结束后自动恢复播放。 - 通过标准 Android 媒体会话适配音乐应用。 ### 📦 安装与使用 - Android 13+（API 33+），已获取 Root 权限，并启用支持 libxposed API 102 的 LSPosed 框架。 - 可正常使用的系统默认文字转语音引擎（TTS）。SongCue 使用其默认语音，不强制指定语言。 - 安装 SongCue，在 LSPosed 中启用模块并勾选音乐应用作为作用域，然后重启这些应用。 - 打开 SongCue，设置歌手播报方式。 兼容性取决于播放器的媒体会话实现。播报可能在音乐开始播放后触发，单曲循环不保证触发播报。
